notes.title: Demo 2.0 has landed!
notes.content:
First update on Steam! Welcome there :-) Let me thank you for following Ama's Lullaby on Steam. It's a pleasure to see that you are about 250 followers over here!

I wanted to inform you that a polished version of the demo has just been published, with a lot of bug fixes & improvements, including:

a new bonus level available when the demo is finished, for you to try the shooting training out (which is a bit challenging, you'll see!)
4k resolution support
improved functionalities with the command-line based console:

commands are not case sensitive anymore!
added many commands aliases (remove -> rm, list -> ls, dir...)
added keyboard shortcuts to navigate in the network view or in the console text fields. You can drop your mouse away!
added commands history, using up/down arrow keys
dialogue lines skipping with space key or mouse click
graphics update
...and a lot of minor changes!

This updated version should be much more pleasant to play, with less frustration for those who didn't manage to defeat the title menu the first time ;-)

If you want to try it out, I recommend strongly taking a look at the updated user manual, at least to learn about the main keyboard shortcuts when the laptop is open.

The final game may be ready for 2027. I'm working hard on it. In the meantime, feel free to drop by and say hello in the Steam Community or on the Discord channel! Will you share some screenshots of your high scores at the shooting training? : )

Thanks again!
